# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Look for the specific data points that have been collected related to industrial emissions.
3. Identify the times when these emissions were excessive.
4. Check if there are any correlations or patterns in the data that could indicate why the emissions were excessive.
5. Record the detected excessive emissions and any related notes in the emissions tracking system.
6. Include the date and time of the excessive emissions in the air-quality report.
7. Explain the cause of the excessive emissions, if known from the data.
8. Add any other relevant observations or conclusions from the data analysis. Include any insights gained from the monitoring records and additional data sources.
9. Review all sections of the air-quality report for consistency and accuracy.
